WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT s_store_id as store_id,
           ss_ext_sales_price as sales,
           ss_net_profit as profit,
           sr_return_amt as returns,
           sr_net_loss as profit_loss
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store_returns sr ON (ss_store_sk = sr_store_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = sr_returned_date_sk)
),
catalog_data AS (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id as catalog_id,
           cs_ext_sales_price as sales,
           cs_net_profit as profit,
           cr_return_amt as returns,
           cr_net_loss as profit_loss
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON (cs_catalog_page_sk = cr_catalog_page_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = cr_returned_date_sk)
),
web_data AS (
    SELECT web_site_id as web_id,
           ws_ext_sales_price as sales,
           ws_net_profit as profit,
           wr_return_amt as returns,
           wr_net_loss as profit_loss
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_returns wr ON (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number)
)
SELECT 'store' as channel, store_id as id, 
       sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) as profit
FROM sales_data
UNION ALL
SELECT 'catalog' as channel, catalog_id as id, 
       sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) as profit
FROM catalog_data
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web' as channel, web_id as id, 
       sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) as profit
FROM web_data
